name: Theoretical Capacity Calculator
description: Calculate theoretical specific capacity from a chemical formula and a user-supplied electron-transfer number in your browser.
features: Browser-local calculation of Q = nF / (3.6M) in mAh/g
Chemical formula parsing and elemental atomic weights
Displays molar mass, electron count and substituted equation
Electron count is supplied by the user; no automatic oxidation-state inference

history.notes: The theoretical capacity calculator is available on AimatraLab, with formula-based calculations and user-supplied electron counts.

features: 在浏览器本地按 Q = nF / (3.6M) 计算比容量，单位为 mAh/g
支持化学式解析与元素原子量计算
显示摩尔质量、电子转移数及代入后的公式
